canonicalOrdering.exactMovesAndReplies: ASCII lexical exact move key ascending unless an explicitly score-ranked table is required
canonicalOrdering.selectedRoots: phase ASCII ascending, then quotaRank ASCII ascending, then historicalTrajectoryHash, rawStateKey, seed
canonicalOrdering.featureOrder: PCRPR_FEATURES_STAGE0_V1 family order then within-family ASCII feature name

hashing.first32: parse first 8 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digits as unsigned 32-bit integer
hashing.canonicalJsonObjects: object keys ASCII ascending recursively; arrays retain frozen semantic order

targetArithmetic.mediumWinRate: left-to-right binary64 sum of 16 integer 0/1 values divided by 16
targetArithmetic.weakWinRate: left-to-right binary64 sum of 8 integer 0/1 values divided by 8

standardization.mean: left-to-right binary64 sum divided by training count
standardization.populationVariance: left-to-right binary64 sum of squared deviations from frozen mean divided by training count

ridgeRegression.design: standardized active feature columns plus unstandardized intercept column
ridgeRegression.normalEquations: X'X and X'y accumulated rowIdentity ascending, feature index ascending
ridgeRegression.penalty: ridge lambda added only to active-feature diagonal, not intercept diagonal
ridgeRegression.solver: deterministic lower-triangular Cholesky decomposition of symmetric positive-definite normal matrix
ridgeRegression.choleskyLoops: i ascending; j 0..i ascending; inner k ascending
ridgeRegression.prediction: intercept plus left-to-right featureIndex-ascending coefficient*standardizedFeature accumulation

spearman.ranking: average 1-based rank for exact-equal numeric ties after numeric ascending sort; rowIdentity used only as deterministic secondary ordering and does not break exact numeric ties
spearman.correlation: Pearson correlation of the two average-rank vectors using rowIdentity ascending accumulation

topScoreQuintile.enrichment: mean primaryLift in top group minus mean primaryLift in all remaining rows

metrics.phaseMetrics: same formulas restricted to phase rows without refitting

candidateSelection.tieDefinition: exact binary64 equality only; no epsilon

finalFit.rows: all development-eligible rows sorted rowIdentity ascending
finalFit.preprocessing: recompute mean/scale on all development rows under same rules
finalFit.model: fit selected family set and lambda under same ridge algorithm
finalFit.serialization: feature names/order, means, scales, coefficients, intercept and lambda serialized canonically with numeric values additionally bound by big-endian binary64 hex
